description: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.

feature.name: Aquatic Attacker - Passive
feature.text: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d6** damage.

feature.name: Tail Swat - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage.

feature.name: Drag and Bag - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily _Restrain_ them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets _Restrained_ in this way.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, drown, restrain
name: Ahuizotl

description: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.

feature.name: Wind Lord - Passive
feature.text: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

feature.name: Stone of Omens - Passive
feature.text: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

feature.name: Archer's Bane - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid, escape, misdirect
name: Atototl

description: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.

feature.name: Surprise! - Passive
feature.text: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d8** damage.

feature.name: Brutal - Reaction
feature.text: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to deal an extra **1d6** damage.

feature.name: Warheart - Reaction
feature.text: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can **spend a Fear** to negate it.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things
name: Bugboar

description: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal **1d8** physical damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Survival Instinct - Reaction
feature.text: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Do violence, seek security and survival
name: Common Ruffian

description: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.

feature.name: Minion (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Skin-Crawling - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Darkweave Venom - Reaction
feature.text: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can **mark a Stress** to _Exhaust_ the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While _Exhausted_, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

motives_and_tactics: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening
name: Darkweave Crawler

description: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Den Mother - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **spend 2 Fear** to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

feature.name: Quicker Than She Looks - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

feature.name: Darkfang Envenomation - Reaction
feature.text: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces
name: Darkweave Queen

description: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

feature.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

feature.name: Shadow Fang - Reaction
feature.text: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Shaky_ until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While _Shaky_, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Bite, stick to the darkness
name: Darkweave Spinner

description: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.

feature.name: Horde (1d4) - Passive
feature.text: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4** physical damage instead.

feature.name: "Get 'em Off, Get 'em Off!" - Reaction
feature.text: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can **mark a Stress** to make the target temporarily _Covered in Spiders._ While _Covered_ _in Spiders,_ the target must roll a **d6** when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes
name: Darkweave Swarmlings

description: A large deer.

feature.name: Headbutt - Passive
feature.text: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals **1d12+2** physical damage instead of its standard damage.

feature.name: Bolt - Reaction
feature.text: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

motives_and_tactics: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger
name: Elk

description: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.

feature.name: Nimble Flyer - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

feature.name: Dive Bomb - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Circle, clutch, dive, spy
name: Falcon

description: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.

feature.name: Horde (1d4+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Cowardly - Reaction
feature.text: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a **d6**. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos
name: Grimmling Warband

description: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.

feature.name: Toxic Aura - Passive
feature.text: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

feature.name: Swooping Attack - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals **3d6** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly
name: Harpy

description: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.

feature.name: Captivating - Passive
feature.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.

feature.name: Heart's Desire - Passive
feature.text: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

feature.name: Shapeshifter - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

feature.name: Enchant - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become _Enchanted_ until they take damage. While _Enchanted_, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

motives_and_tactics: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers
name: Kelpie

description: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.

feature.name: Libre - Passive
feature.text: The Masque Muerte can't be _Restrained_.

feature.name: Heel Turn - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily _Vulnerable_ as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

feature.name: Spectral Suplex - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte suplex a _Restrained_ PC, dealing **1d10+6** magic damage to them.

feature.name: Unmasking Death - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

feature.name: Tag Team - Reaction
feature.text: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to have a spectral wrestler appear and _Pin_ the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While _Pinned_, the target is _Restrained_ and takes an extra **1d12** magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

motives_and_tactics: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground
name: Masque Muerte

description: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.

feature.name: Hive Mind - Passive
feature.text: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

feature.name: Adaptive Tactics - Passive
feature.text: _Pool._ When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

motives_and_tactics: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary
name: Mechanorb

description: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Stolen Armor - Passive
feature.text: _Countdown._ When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged Mountain Troll").

feature.name: Flail Swipe - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

feature.name: Enraged Mountain Troll - Evolution
feature.text: The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack: **Claw Swipe:** Very Close | 1d10+3 phy

feature.name: Double Swipe - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to move up to Close range and make two standard attacks against a target within Melee range. If both attacks succeed, combine the damage, and the target loses a Hope.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp
name: Mountain Troll

description: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

feature.name: Grapple - Action
feature.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

feature.name: Squirt Ink - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

motives_and_tactics: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape
name: Octopus

description: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.

feature.name: Shadow Stalker - Passive
feature.text: While _Hidden_, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

feature.name: Pouncing Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **1d12+2** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Climb trees, pounce, stalk
name: Panther

description: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.

feature.name: Incorporeal - Passive
feature.text: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

feature.name: Fear Aura - Passive
feature.text: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

feature.name: Lingering Haunt - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (1d6)._ When the Phantom is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings
name: Phantom

description: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.

feature.name: Specter - Passive
feature.text: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Possessor - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

feature.name: Ghost Storm - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **1d12+2** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room
name: Poltergeist

description: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.

feature.name: Horde (1d4+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Come Back Worse - Reaction
feature.text: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

motives_and_tactics: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around
name: Rabble Mawb

description: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.

feature.name: Horde (1d4+2) - Passive
feature.text: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Ankle Weights - Passive
feature.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

motives_and_tactics: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls
name: Redcap Biters

description: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

feature.name: Backbreaker - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **3d4+10** physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is _Restrained_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Kneecapper - Reaction
feature.text: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target temporarily _Vulnerable._

motives_and_tactics: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly
name: Redcap Breaker

description: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.

feature.name: Chop Happy - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Knife Thrower - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is _Hidden,_ they make the attack with advantage.

motives_and_tactics: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble
name: Redcap Butcher

description: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.

feature.name: Hand of Glory - Passive
feature.text: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is _Hidden._

feature.name: Torchbearer - Passive
feature.text: The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

feature.name: Dance in the Flames - Action
feature.text: **Spend a token** from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light
name: Redcap Candlemaker

description: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

feature.name: Minion (4) - Passive
feature.text: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Shallow Cuts - Passive
feature.text: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice
name: Redcap Skinner

description: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Child of Night - Passive
feature.text: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

feature.name: Bloodthirsty - Passive
feature.text: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

feature.name: Howl at the Moon - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

feature.name: Flesh Ripper - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **1d12+2** direct physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize
name: Rugaru

description: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.

feature.name: Ka-Chomp - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **1d12** physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

feature.name: Feeding Frenzy - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature marks HP, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

feature.name: Scaly - Reaction
feature.text: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a **d6**. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

motives_and_tactics: Clamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline
name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast

description: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Broken Magic - Action
feature.text:
**Mark a Stress** to roll a **d6**. The Mage uses the corresponding move:  
1-2: _Dimension Rift._ Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes **2d6** direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.  
3-4: _Time Dilation._ Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is _Slowed_ until they roll with Hope. While _Slowed_, a target is _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress when they move.  
5-6: _Discordant Visions._ Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take **2d8** direct magic damage.

feature.name: Feel My Pain - Reaction
feature.text: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of **d6s** equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control
name: Soul-Shattered Mage

description: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.

feature.name: Tireless - Passive
feature.text: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

feature.name: Clatter & Recombobulate - Reaction
feature.text: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

motives_and_tactics: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently
name: Spellbound Armor

description: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.

feature.name: Minion (4) - Passive
feature.text: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Venomous - Passive
feature.text: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily _Envenomated_. While _Envenomated_, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Lie in wait, slither, strike
name: Viper

description: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: No Vital Organs - Passive
feature.text: The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

feature.name: Wax Ball - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes **1d12+2** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

feature.name: Splutch! - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a **d6**. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

feature.name: Smothering Grapple - Reaction
feature.text: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to _Trap_ the target inside the Creation's wax body. While _Trapped_, the target is _Restrained_ and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A _Trapped_ creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

motives_and_tactics: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother
name: Waxwork Creation

description: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.

feature.name: Horde (1d4-1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4-1** magic damage instead.

feature.name: Kaleidoscopic - Passive
feature.text: The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are _Vulnerable._

feature.name: Fascinating - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

motives_and_tactics: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray
name: Will-O’-The-Wisps

description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.

feature.name: Telepathic - Passive
feature.text: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

feature.name: Psychic Strongbox - Passive
feature.text: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

feature.name: Glitch Wave - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

feature.name: Temporal Corrosion - Reaction
feature.text: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

motives_and_tactics: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows
name: Yufo

description: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.

feature.name: Specter - Passive
feature.text: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Scare Tactic - Action
feature.text: Up to three times per scene, **spend a Fear** to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks **1d4** Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

feature.name: Wail of Despair - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d12+1** magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush from inside solid objects, frighten to death, mourn life and beauty lost, scream balefully
name: Banshee

description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.

feature.name: Petrify - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes _Stiff_. If the target is already _Stiff_, they become _Petrified._ While _Stiff_, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While _Petrified_, the PC can't act. The _Petrified_ condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

feature.name: CRONCH! - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Basilisk chomp down on a _Petrified_ PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

motives_and_tactics: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait
name: Basilisk

description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

feature.name: Pack Fury - Passive
feature.text: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

feature.name: Bark at the Moon - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

feature.name: Berserker Rage - Reaction
feature.text: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies
name: Berserker Alpha

description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

feature.name: Pack Fury - Passive
feature.text: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

feature.name: Berserker Rage - Reaction
feature.text: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon
name: Berserker Initiate

description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.

feature.name: Flanking Maneuver - Passive
feature.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

feature.name: Eye of the Sage - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19-20.

feature.name: Trample - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d6+2** physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Quick Volley - Reaction
feature.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can **mark any number of Stress** to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

motives_and_tactics: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders
name: Centaur Warden

description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

feature.name: Fast - Passive
feature.text: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Pin - Reaction
feature.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target. The Hut drags the _Restrained_ target when it moves.

motives_and_tactics: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample
name: Chicken-Foot Hut

description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

feature.name: Armor Eater - Passive
feature.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

feature.name: Blade Spin - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** physical damage.

feature.name: Blade Fling - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.

feature.name: Keratin Scales - Reaction
feature.text: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

motives_and_tactics: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger
name: Dire Pangolati

description: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.

feature.name: Blink Beast - Passive
feature.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you **spend a Fear** to conjure it again.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive
name: Doppelhound

description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

feature.name: High Ground - Passive
feature.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

feature.name: Leaping Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

feature.name: Comeback - Reaction
feature.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the attack with advantage.

motives_and_tactics: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above
name: Dragon Knight

description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

feature.name: Trample - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d10+3** physical damage.

feature.name: Toss - Reaction
feature.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra **1d12** damage.

motives_and_tactics: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize
name: Elephant

description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Bloody Strike - Passive
feature.text: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Screeching Caterwaul - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become _Rattled_ until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a _Rattled_ PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the _Rattled_ condition from the target.

feature.name: I Alone - Reaction
feature.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

feature.name: Vicious Reprisal - Reaction
feature.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against that PC.

motives_and_tactics: Rush attack, shred, terrify
name: Entombed Cat Beast

description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

feature.name: Battle Formation - Passive
feature.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

feature.name: Javelin - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one
name: Entombed Elite Guard

description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

feature.name: Empty Husk - Passive
feature.text: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

feature.name: Missing Organs - Passive
feature.text: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

feature.name: Grasping Chains - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals **2d8** physical damage, and temporarily _Restrains_ them.

feature.name: Deathless Obedience - Action
feature.text: Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Accursed Caress - Reaction
feature.text: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

feature.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change) - Reaction
feature.text: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Command inferiors, curse the invaders
name: Entombed Empress

description: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.

feature.name: Invigorate - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

feature.name: Last Grasp - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and _Restrain_ them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target _Restrained_ in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Chill Touch - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark **1d4** Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon
name: Entombed Necropriest

description: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.

feature.name: Horde (2d4+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Momentum - Passive
feature.text: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Omophagous - Action
feature.text: **Mark a HP** to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and _Infecting_ them. While _Infected_, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing
name: Entombed Skin Beetles

description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.

feature.name: Minion (5) - Passive
feature.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: The Work Never Ends - Reaction
feature.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can **spend a Fear** to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Never stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress
name: Entombed Stonemason

description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

feature.name: Horde (1d6+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d6+1** magic damage instead.

feature.name: Maddening Cacophony - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become _Vulnerable_ until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

motives_and_tactics: Caw incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes
name: Flock of Feather Fiends

description: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Dread Honk - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become _Vulnerable_ until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

motives_and_tactics: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs
name: Fowlbear

description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

feature.name: Minion (6) - Passive
feature.text: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Form Up - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid violence, spray attackers
name: Fungispunj Sporeling

description: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.

feature.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become _Poisoned_ until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While _Poisoned_, a target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Reanimator - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

feature.name: Colony - Action
feature.text: **Mark any number of Stress** to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

feature.name: Mind Meld - Reaction
feature.text: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

motives_and_tactics: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores
name: Fungispunj Sporophore

description: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.

feature.name: Unliving - Passive
feature.text: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

feature.name: Swooping Strike - Action
feature.text: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

feature.name: Petrifying Slash - Reaction
feature.text: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Vulnerable_. If the target is already _Vulnerable,_ they become _Restrained_. If the target is already _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained,_ they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

motives_and_tactics: Hide in plain sight, overwatch, swoop down
name: Gargoyle

description: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Armed and Dangerous - Passive
feature.text: When the Octopus first appears, place a **d8** on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

feature.name: Grapple - Action
feature.text: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Octopus _Grapple_ the target. While _Grappled_, the target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

feature.name: Crush - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to deal **3d8** direct physical damage to a target _Grappled_ by the Octopus.

motives_and_tactics: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey
name: Giant Octopus

description: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis - Passive
feature.text: The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

feature.name: Tentacle Rays - Action
feature.text:
**Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a **d8** for a random beam attack or **spend a Fear** to choose instead: 
1. _Beguile._ The Gobstalker _Beguiles_ the target. While _Beguiled_, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a _Beguiled_ PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A _Beguiled_ PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition. 
2. _Corrode._ The target takes **2d8** magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage. 
3. _Doom._ The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount. 
4. _Hypnosis._ The target falls into a _Deep Trance_ and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16). 
5. _Paralyze._ The target freezes in place, becoming _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they mark 2 Stress. 
6. _Sear._ The target takes **2d8** direct magic damage. 
7. _Scare._ The target is _Scared_. While _Scared_, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16). 
8. _Slow._ The target becomes _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

feature.name: Leech Lick - Reaction
feature.text: On a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush rivals, seek riches, shoot beams
name: Gobstalker

description: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.

feature.name: The Beast Unleashed - Passive
feature.text: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

feature.name: Guahalan Sacrifice - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

feature.name: Howl of the Guahala - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily _Panicked_. While _Panicked_, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

feature.name: Rip & Tear - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can **mark a Stress** to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

feature.name: Brutal Spectacle - Reaction
feature.text: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can **spend a Fear** to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Destroy, give no quarter, ravage
name: Guahalan Alebrujo

description: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.

feature.name: Pack Alpha - Passive
feature.text: _Pool_. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can **spend a token** from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

feature.name: Unleash the Beast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

feature.name: Call of the Guahala - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

feature.name: Feral Form (Phase Change) - Reaction
feature.text: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Bolster allies, lead the pack, rally the troops
name: Guahalan Fang Lord

description: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.

feature.name: Unleash the Beast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

feature.name: Pack Attack - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

motives_and_tactics: Escape, profit, throw smoke
name: Guahalan Shifter

description: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.

feature.name: Minion (5) - Passive
feature.text: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Ethereal Form - Passive
feature.text: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Beast Bomb - Reaction
feature.text: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

motives_and_tactics: Protect, sacrifice, surround
name: Guahalan Spirit Beast

description: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.

feature.name: Unleash the Beast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

feature.name: Beast-Caller - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer summon **2d4** Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

feature.name: Rage of Spirits - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

feature.name: Spiritual Sacrifice - Reaction
feature.text: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can **spend a Fear** to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

motives_and_tactics: Abjure, bolster, summon
name: Guahalan Spirit Singer

description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Momentum - Passive
feature.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Gullible - Passive
feature.text: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

feature.name: Bug Swarm - Passive
feature.text: PCs are _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

feature.name: Mighty Swing - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds
name: Hill Titan

description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.

feature.name: Blood Honey - Action
feature.text: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** magic damage and become temporarily _Restrained_ as the honey hardens on them.

feature.name: Bee-Ruption - Reaction
feature.text: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take **1d8** direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. _Restrained_ targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

motives_and_tactics: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive
name: Hive Walker

description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

feature.name: Minion (4) - Passive
feature.text: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to gain an additional Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories
name: Jack-O’-Lantern

description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.

feature.name: Burrowing - Passive
feature.text: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.

feature.name: Thick-Skinned - Passive
feature.text: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

feature.name: Rending Chomp - Reaction
feature.text: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives_and_tactics: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey
name: Landshark

description: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Deep Diver - Passive
feature.text: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.

feature.name: Steel-Skinned - Passive
feature.text: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

feature.name: Forceful Eruption - Action
feature.text: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they make an action roll. For each PC made _Vulnerable_ in this way, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground
name: Landshark Behemoth

description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

feature.name: Tongue Attack - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and _Restrained_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can **spend a Fear** to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

feature.name: Devour - Action
feature.text: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

feature.name: Never Just One - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape
name: Ravenous Mockery

description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.

feature.name: Stifling Pheromones - Passive
feature.text: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

feature.name: Rust Touch - Passive
feature.text: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal
name: Rust Eater

description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

feature.name: Made of Straw - Passive
feature.text: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

feature.name: Terror Vision - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing **2d8** magic damage and making them _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

motives_and_tactics: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw
name: Scarecrow

description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.

feature.name: Minion (5) - Passive
feature.text: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Art of Invisibility - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make the Sprite _Hidden_ until they attack.

feature.name: Dream Petal Poison - Action
feature.text: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Sleepy_ until the target takes damage. While _Sleepy_, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness
name: Sprite

description: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Skillful Strike - Passive
feature.text: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can **mark a Stress** and roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

feature.name: Sunlight Sickness - Passive
feature.text: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a **d4**. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

feature.name: Hammer Smash - Action
feature.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives_and_tactics: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude
name: Stone Titan

description: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

feature.name: Leathery Hide - Passive
feature.text: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can **mark any number of Stress** instead of an equal number of HP.

feature.name: Tail Swipe - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **5d6** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

feature.name: Bull Rush - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal **3d10** direct physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole
name: Triceratops

description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

feature.name: Earth-Shaking Roar - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.

feature.name: Stomp - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **3d12** direct physical damage.

feature.name: Crushing Bite - Reaction
feature.text: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an additional HP.

motives_and_tactics: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around
name: Tyrannosaurus

description: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

feature.name: Fearmonger - Passive
feature.text: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Terror-Fueled - Passive
feature.text: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

feature.name: Fear Eater - Action
feature.text: **Spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can **spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of HP.

feature.name: Baleful Gaze - Reaction
feature.text: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

motives_and_tactics: Feed, frighten, hunt
name: Urco

description: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.

feature.name: To Me, My Pretties - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, summon **2d4** Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

feature.name: Shadow Strangler - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks **1d4** Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

feature.name: Corpse Whisperer - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a **d6**. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

feature.name: Vexing Word - Reaction
feature.text: After a PC makes a roll, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

motives_and_tactics: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers
name: Valdenhax

description: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Orbiting Aegis - Passive
feature.text: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a **d6** Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a **d6**. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

feature.name: Force Salvo - Action
feature.text: **Spend any number of Fear** and roll that many **d4s**. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

feature.name: Fireball - Action
feature.text: **Mark any number of Stress** to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d10** magic damage.

feature.name: Counterspell - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

motives_and_tactics: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power
name: Archmage

description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

feature.name: Attracted to Wealth - Passive
feature.text: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

feature.name: The Weight of Opulence - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

feature.name: Expensive Failure - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

motives_and_tactics: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything
name: Catrin

description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.

feature.name: Rending Jaws - Passive
feature.text: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

feature.name: Double Claw - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Breath of Fire - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d12** magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

feature.name: Serpent Strike - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to attack the PC first. On a success, deal **4d4+10** physical damage and _Poison_ them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While _Poisoned,_ the target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle
name: Chimera

description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: "Awww..." - Passive
feature.text: When the Lepus first appears, it is _Too Cute_. To attack a _Too Cute_ creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the _Too Cute_ condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Leaping Jugular Strike - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20** direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Evasive - Reaction
feature.text: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a **d6**. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

feature.name: "Run Away!" - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

motives_and_tactics: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around
name: Crimson Lepus

description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Psychic Screech - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take **3d8** direct magic damage and become _Vulnerable_ until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

feature.name: Shadow Swarm - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are _Vulnerable_ while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

feature.name: Paranoia Glare - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them _Paranoid_. While _Paranoid_, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

motives_and_tactics: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows
name: Cryptimoth

description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

feature.name: Fish-Tailed - Passive
feature.text: The Merfolk is _Vulnerable_ out of the water.

feature.name: Gang Up - Passive
feature.text: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

feature.name: "Get Over Here!" - Reaction
feature.text: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can **spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

motives_and_tactics: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage
name: Cursed Merfolk

description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

feature.name: Psychic Blast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take **3d10+4** direct magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until spotlighted.

feature.name: Brain Drain - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a _Vulnerable_ PC within Very Close range. The target marks **1d4** Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

feature.name: Call of the Deep - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to summon **1d4** Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

feature.name: Mucosal Contamination - Action
feature.text: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is _Restrained_ until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs _Restrained_ in this way take **3d8** direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures _Restrained_ by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.
